description: This file defines the PolicyEntry interface in Java representing a single entry within a policy, including methods to create instances, retrieve label, subjects, resources, and serialize to JSON, as well as defining relevant JSON fields.

classes.name: PolicyEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a policy entry with methods for creation, data access, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: PolicyEntry.JsonFields
classes.description: Inner class defining JSON field definitions for PolicyEntry.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry with specified label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions, specifically JsonSchemaVersion.V_2.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of this policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the subjects of this policy entry.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the resources of this policy entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to JSON including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (with parameters)
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to JSON with specific schema version and field selector.
